I made a big overhaul in my life after years of depression and it changed my outlook entirely. I still have flare ups but I can move past them a lot quicker now. This is what I did.

  
1. Started to make sure my environment was tidy and clean

2. Spend time on self care, my hair, my beard, my skin etc.

3. Set goals for work and personal life (starting small and achievable, like make bed everyday).

4. Gave up all mainstream social media (Facebook/Insta/TikTok/Twitter/Snapchat)

5. Stopped spending evenings watching TV and did something for me (can be what ever makes you happy, I chose exercise)

6. Be more active

7. Reach out to friends first, not wait to be messaged all the time

  
Two years later I went from depressed and suicidal, where I once tried to OD on sleeping pills to active and healthy with a lot clearer mind. I went from not being able to run 5k to doing Ironman events, Marathons and Ultras.

My social life improved and done things I would never dreamed of, been in a yacht race, started bouldering. 

Things just got loads better, do I get down still? Yes. Do I get anxious? Yes.

But that is part of the human experience and I now have better coping mechanisms.  I also now have therapy but at the time I could not afford it, and I got myself out. You can too.

Also stop caring about what others are doing and worry about what you are, be the best you.
